analysis_summary: The ontology is designed to simulate the complex geopolitical relationship between Thailand and Cambodia. It focuses on state actors (officials, diplomats, agencies), influencers of public opinion (media, analysts, activists), and institutional bodies (political parties, military units). This structure allows for the simulation of diplomatic negotiations, media narratives, and public reactions to border frictions and political shifts.
